title: Creating Studio Redirects to Demo Studio
description: Bug: when creating a studio it redirects to demo studio instead of creating/opening a new one. createStudio correctly creates a catalog entry and navigates to /studios/{id}, but the studio app always boots from demo_studio_projection(), openStudio never loads the catalog document, and boot setActiveExample("demo") can override the URL to /studios/demo.
summary: Fixed create-studio redirecting to demo: openStudio now loads the catalog/example envelope via HostEffect::LoadDocument, shells apply it with loadAppDocument, boot setActiveExample no longer overrides studio routes, and StudioApp starts empty instead of demo_studio_projection. Verified with s-plugin unit tests (create_studio_navigates_to_fresh_id_not_demo, open_studio_*, initial_projection_is_empty_not_demo).
